name: Japan Masters
stakes: This week, India aims to cap off a strong run with a Super 500 title, further solidifying its presence on the global badminton stage and building momentum towards the Tour Finals.
summary:
India's campaign at the Japan Masters has been electrified by **Lakshya Sen**, who has powered his way into the men's singles final. Coming off a recent triumph at the Hylo Open, Sen has continued his impressive form, overcoming Alwi Farhan in a hard-fought semifinal. He now faces Koni Watanabe in what promises to be a thrilling championship clash, with a Super 500 title firmly in his sights. 

While Sen carries the flag into the final, the progress of other Indian shuttlers remains to be seen. India's top men's doubles pair, **Satwik & Chirag**, entered the tournament as the fourth seeds, looking to make a deep run. Similarly, **PV Sindhu**, a consistent force on the circuit, aimed for a strong performance to bolster her Tour Finals qualification. 

The tournament also features rising talents like **Treesa & Gayatri** in women's doubles, and veteran **HS Prannoy** in men's singles, all seeking to leave their mark in Kumamoto. With Sen's stellar run, the focus is squarely on the final, hoping for another Indian victory on the BWF Tour.
